ns2:section.sectionText: Students must also register for NRES 294 (CRN 51278), which provides an additional hour of credit (type the CRN into a box at the bottom of the registration page). In this service learning course, visit area schools (grades 4-8) to teach students about the impacts of introduced species using science-based information. Also, facilitate student-developed community stewardship projects to help reduce the spread of aquatic invaders. Guest scientists and the Nab the Aquatic Invader! Web site (www.sgnis.org/kids) will serve as the foundation for the course. Section CS3 will be working in Thomas Paine Elementary School 11:00-12:00 on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Students are responsible for their own transportation. NO PREREQUISITES REQUIRED. No field trip fee.
